title: Approve supplier payments
context: You approve supplier payments in a practice system, so no real money moves. Approve a payment only when the purchase order matches, the invoice is attached and the bank account matches the supplier file.

request.title: Payment request

checks.label: Bank account in the supplier file

request.held: Held until Lakeside confirms its bank account. Nothing is sent.
request.approved: Approved. Tonight's payment run sends $860 to the account ending 1190, not the account in the supplier file.
request.notStopped: Still approved. Tonight's payment run sends $860 to the account ending 1190.

steps.text: Change the supplier file to the account ending 1190
steps.feedback: The supplier file is the record you check against. Changing it to match the request removes the check.

steps.text: Call Lakeside on the number in the supplier file
steps.feedback: The phone number on the request may belong to whoever changed the account.

steps.text: Cancel the payment before tonight's run
steps.feedback: Only cancelling keeps this payment out of tonight's payment run.

colleague.name: Dana
colleague.title: Payment approved by Dana
colleague.summary: Dana, another approver, approved this payment of $1,150 to Harbour Signs and has left for the day. You can cancel it before tonight's payment run.
colleague.approved: Approved by Dana. Tonight's payment run sends $1,150 to Harbour Signs with no invoice attached.
colleague.notStopped: Still approved. Tonight's payment run sends $1,150 to Harbour Signs.

steps.text: Ask Harbour Signs for the invoice
steps.feedback: The payment needs the invoice attached before anyone approves it.

steps.text: Cancel the payment before tonight's run
steps.feedback: Only cancelling keeps this payment out of tonight's payment run.

steps.text: Leave it. Dana approved it, so it is Dana's call.
steps.feedback: You can cancel it, and Dana has left for the day. If you leave it, tonight's payment run sends the money.

steps.text: Tell Dana the invoice was missing
steps.feedback: Dana will know to check for the invoice next time.
